تزامنت (form VI)
# تَزَامَنْتُ (tazāmantu) /ta.zaː.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
# تَزَامَنْتَ (tazāmanta) /ta.zaː.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
# تَزَامَنْتِ (tazāmanti) /ta.zaː.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
# تَزَامَنَتْ (tazāmanat) /ta.zaː.ma.nat/: third-person fem
